long_biography.plain_text:
Oxford’s business school is the most visible institution created through Wafic Rida Saïd’s philanthropy. His founding support enabled the school’s establishment in 1996, while later gifts funded scholarships and a global leadership centre. The university recognises him as the school’s founding benefactor, and Somerville College appointed him a Foundation Fellow.

Saïd also established the Saïd Foundation, directing its work towards education, humanitarian support and medical research. Its long-running scholarship programme serves students connected to Syria, Jordan, Lebanon and Palestine. Other grants have supported displaced children and medical institutions, giving the foundation a durable role across the Levant and the United Kingdom.
